name: Ahmad bin Hassan
bio:
Ahmad's fascination with aerodynamics began during his childhood, observing the flight patterns of kites soaring above the rice paddies near his village. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at the University of Malaya, focusing on fluid dynamics. His career started at a local automotive manufacturer, where he honed his skills in aerodynamic testing and optimization. Seeking a greater challenge, Ahmad transitioned to motorsport, working with smaller racing teams before landing a role as a wind tunnel operator.

Ahmad's meticulous approach to data analysis, combined with his intuitive understanding of airflow, allows him to quickly identify subtle improvements in vehicle design. He is known for his rigorous testing methodologies and his ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for engineers. He is a strong believer in continuous improvement and consistently seeks out new technologies and techniques to enhance his skills.

What sets Ahmad apart is his commitment to precision and his unwavering dedication to achieving optimal aerodynamic performance. He is a patient and observant operator, always looking for ways to refine testing procedures and ensure the accuracy of results. His calm demeanor and collaborative spirit make him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.description: Ahmad is a man of medium build with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn aerodynamic sketches.
Insists on cleaning the wind tunnel viewing window himself before each session.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when analyzing data.
